dct_title_s: State of New Jersey Board of Commerce and Navigation. Map Showing Riparian Lands in Vicinity of Morris Canal Basins, Jersey City, N.J.
dct_description_sm: This map is a combination road map, grant map, and high water line map. It shows the 1804 high water line for the tidewater basin.
